title: Rebuild triggers — Index Rebuild Scheduler (Signature)
description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. The index rebuild scheduler decides when an index needs rebuilding, plans the rebuild to avoid disrupting live traffic, and executes it safely — full or incremental, online or offline. Rebuilds are expensive and risky; the scheduler weighs staleness against cost, picks low-traffic windows, builds the new index alongside the old, and flips traffic only after verification. It turns 'rebuild the index' from a scary manual operation into routine maintenance.
